textbook: Clean cutaway textbook illustration of a SINGLE human urothelial (umbrella) cell, a large dome-shaped animal cell from the bladder's transitional epithelium, centered in a square 1:1 1080x1080 frame with lots of negative space around structures for later labels. Anatomically faithful eukaryotic animal cell.
